basic.name: 普通攻击：星轨连击
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成以太伤害；
其中，第五段攻击为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象对前方圆形区域敌人造成以太伤害；
处于接战状态下且未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得40点[梦境值]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

special.name: 特殊技：死神协奏曲·风暴
special.nameEn: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
特殊技为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方直线区域发动斩击，造成以太伤害；
处于接战状态下且未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：死神协奏曲·破晓
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
强化特殊技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方直线区域发动强力斩击，造成以太伤害；
卢西娅发动[合唱]时，为全队角色施加[破暗]状态；[破暗]状态下，贯穿力提升12点，卢西娅每拥有200点初始最大生命值，可使贯穿力额外提升5.2点，[破暗]状态最多可提升636点贯穿力，状态持续20秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，当卢西娅的初始最大生命值达到24000点时，上述增益效果达到最大值；
[合唱]造成伤害时，卢西娅会根据最大生命值的37%额外提升最后一段攻击的伤害；
卢西娅发动强化特殊技后，若自身处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长16秒；
卢西娅发动强化特殊技后，可以直接衔接第五段[普通攻击]；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得60点[梦境值]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional 5.2 Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of 636, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional 37% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：星尘回响
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
闪避反击为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方圆形区域发动下落攻击，造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：璀色剧场
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
连携技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象将前方圆形区域敌人吸近并造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得40点[梦境值]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：进击，大铠甲！
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
终结技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象，卢西娅骑乘以骸向前突进，保持按住方向键可控制骑乘方向并延长突进时间，最多延长至3秒，突进期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，且卢西娅受到致命伤害时不会战败退场，生命值最多降低至1；
在突进停止时对周身大范围区域发动强力打击造成以太伤害，招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]，招式发动后会留下[星光汇聚之地]，[星光汇聚之地]持续8秒，当前操作中的角色在[星光汇聚之地]内获得生命回复效果：每秒回复卢西娅最大生命值的1.05%，该回复效果在角色离开[星光汇聚之地]4秒后或下场时消失；
若发动后卢西娅处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长32秒；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得100点[梦境值]，且若发动此[合唱]时自身处于[梦境]状态，则可在下一次退出[梦境]状态时获得100点[梦境值]并重新进入[梦境]状态，该效果不可重复获得；
强力打击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to 1.05% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：迷雾重击
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速支援为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方圆形区域发动下落攻击，造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
This Quick Assist is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：幻梦之声
defensiveAssist.nameEn: Defensive Assist: Voice of Illusory Dreams
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams

未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得40点[梦境值]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:

If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 在突进停止时对周身大范围区域发动强力打击造成以太伤害，招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]，招式发动后会留下[星光汇聚之地]，[星光汇聚之地]持续8秒，当前操作中的角色在[星光汇聚之地]内获得生命回复效果：每秒回复卢西娅最大生命值的1.05%，该回复效果在角色离开[星光汇聚之地]4秒后或下场时消失；
facts.textEn: When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to 1.05% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.

facts.text: 进入[梦境]状态时，将触发[快速支援]，并同时开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效期间，全队角色最大生命值提升5%，持续40秒，重复触发延长持续时间，最多延长至300秒；
facts.textEn: When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.

facts.text:
进入战场时，卢西娅立刻获得60点[梦境值]，若在发动[随想]或[合唱]时，卢西娅的[梦境值]达到100点，会进入[梦境]状态；
进入[梦境]状态时，将触发[快速支援]，并同时开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效期间，全队角色最大生命值提升5%，持续40秒，重复触发延长持续时间，最多延长至300秒；
当卢西娅处于[梦境]状态中，发动任意[随想]时，会消耗25点[梦境值]将[随想]升级为[合唱]；其他操作中的角色攻击命中敌人时，会消耗25点[梦境值]发动[追加攻击]，[追加攻击]为[合唱]，卢西娅在发动招式升级或[追加攻击]后，8秒内不会触发[追加攻击]；
卢西娅发动招式升级或[追加攻击]时，会为全队角色施加[巡梦童谣]状态，[巡梦童谣]状态下，角色造成的伤害提升20%，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
[梦境值]不足或离开[以太帷幕]时，卢西娅退出[梦境]状态。
facts.textEn:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 Dream Points. If her Dream Points reaches 100 upon activating a Whim or Harmony, she enters the Dream state.
When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the Dream state, using any Whim consumes 25 Dream Points and upgrades it to Harmony. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 Dream Points to unleash an Aftershock. This Aftershock is a Harmony. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or Aftershock, Aftershock cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an Aftershock, all squad members gain the Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state. While in Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state, DMG dealt increases by 20% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of Dream Points or she leaves the Ether Veil, she exits the Dream state.

cinema.name: 秘密朋友
cinema.description: [巡梦童谣]状态额外附加造成伤害时无视敌人18%全属性伤害抗性和喧响值获取效率提升5%效果；且卢西娅发动招式升级时获得1层[回音]，最多叠加4层，当[巡梦童谣]状态结束时，若卢西娅持有[回音]，则会自动消耗1层并重新为全队角色施加[巡梦童谣]状态。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo, stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.

cinema.name: 魔术大师
cinema.description: 卢西娅处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]内时[合唱]造成的伤害提升15%；拥有[破暗]状态的代理人处于[以太帷幕·涌泉]内时，额外获得贯穿伤害提升15%效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, Harmony deals 15% more DMG. Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring.

cinema.name: 最佳搭档
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 深夜时间
cinema.description: 当场上有[以太帷幕]开启或延长时，卢西娅使全队角色获得100点喧响值，该效果15秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

cinema.name: 梦境守望人
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 永不结束的旅途
cinema.description: 卢西娅处于任意[以太帷幕]内时，会根据自身初始最大生命值的2%提升自身攻击力，且[合唱]必定暴击，[合唱]造成暴击时暴击伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony CRIT DMG increased by 30%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：星轨连击
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成以太伤害；
其中，第五段攻击为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象对前方圆形区域敌人造成以太伤害；
处于接战状态下且未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得40点[梦境值]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：折光
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速打击，造成以太伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Ether DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：死神协奏曲·风暴
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
特殊技为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方直线区域发动斩击，造成以太伤害；
处于接战状态下且未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：死神协奏曲·破晓
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
强化特殊技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方直线区域发动强力斩击，造成以太伤害；
卢西娅发动[合唱]时，为全队角色施加[破暗]状态；[破暗]状态下，贯穿力提升12点，卢西娅每拥有200点初始最大生命值，可使贯穿力额外提升5.2点，[破暗]状态最多可提升636点贯穿力，状态持续20秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，当卢西娅的初始最大生命值达到24000点时，上述增益效果达到最大值；
[合唱]造成伤害时，卢西娅会根据最大生命值的37%额外提升最后一段攻击的伤害；
卢西娅发动强化特殊技后，若自身处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长16秒；
卢西娅发动强化特殊技后，可以直接衔接第五段[普通攻击]；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得60点[梦境值]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional 5.2 Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of 636, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional 37% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：进击，大铠甲！
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
终结技为[合唱]，发动时复现以骸形象，卢西娅骑乘以骸向前突进，保持按住方向键可控制骑乘方向并延长突进时间，最多延长至3秒，突进期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，且卢西娅受到致命伤害时不会战败退场，生命值最多降低至1；
在突进停止时对周身大范围区域发动强力打击造成以太伤害，招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]，招式发动后会留下[星光汇聚之地]，[星光汇聚之地]持续8秒，当前操作中的角色在[星光汇聚之地]内获得生命回复效果：每秒回复卢西娅最大生命值的1.05%，该回复效果在角色离开[星光汇聚之地]4秒后或下场时消失；
若发动后卢西娅处于[梦境]状态且[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效中，则使[以太帷幕·涌泉]的持续时间延长32秒；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[合唱]可获得100点[梦境值]，且若发动此[合唱]时自身处于[梦境]状态，则可在下一次退出[梦境]状态时获得100点[梦境值]并重新进入[梦境]状态，该效果不可重复获得；
强力打击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to 1.05% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：迷雾重击
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速支援为[随想]，发动时复现以骸形象向前方圆形区域发动下落攻击，造成以太伤害；
未处于[梦境]状态中时，卢西娅发动此[随想]可获得20点[梦境值]，5秒内最多获得一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
This Quick Assist is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

145100003.name: 强化特殊技：死神协奏曲·破晓
145100003.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
